notes.title: We've released our new game, war thriller card game Deckline!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, everyone![/h2]

Today, we've released our next project — war thriller card game, Deckline! It's a rare combination of various genres; we've got horror, thriller, war mixed together for you to be fully immersed in this terrifying experience embodying the grit of any modern combat scenario.

Don't forget to [b]leave a review on Steam[/b] if you've enjoyed the gameplay experience in Deckline!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481320/Deckline/

Deckline is an atmospheric war-horror card game. Out of ammo and encircled, you play one last game of Durak to distract from the inevitable. Experience the grit and dread of modern combat through the lens of a board game.

[previewyoutube=WGU2Ho9dHZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Make sure to get the game while it's on a discount! Also, don't be shy, join our [url=https://discord.gg/95J7RcpCFG]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think about all of that! See you all in the game!

notes.title: We need your reviews!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, everyone![/h2]

We would like to start off by saying that we are extremely grateful to everyone who has tried the game out so far. Your support means the world to us!

If you've enjoyed the game and want to help us reach more players, we have a small request: please [b]consider leaving a review on Steam[/b]. Reviews are incredibly important for the visibility and exposure of the game, and every single one makes a big difference. Every review, whether short or detailed, is valuable and contributes to the game’s visibility on the platform.

Thank you once again for being part of our community and helping us grow. We can't wait to share more exciting news regarding our upcoming project with all of you soon!
